name: Dragon CRS-10
about: Dragon CRS-10 (2017-009A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon), launched 2017 Feb 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2017 Feb 21), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
